svg.title: Text and visual leakage across eleven models

cc:Work.dc:title: Text and visual leakage across eleven models
cc:Work.dc:description: Table 4, arXiv:2601.08235v3. Visual leakage exceeds textual leakage for all eleven evaluated models. Visual leakage ranges from 56.9% to 91.6%; text leakage ranges from 20.2% to 45.2%. Rates are on negative cases where disclosure violates the privacy norm. Lower is better.
